name: Normal dungeons: boss kit spells deal Normal damage, never a one-shot
contract: On Normal, a boss kit spell listed in coa_dungeon_normal_spell_damage deals Ascension's own Normal rank damage when its caster is below level 50: Aku'mai's level-60 Poison Bolt Storm (2102617) hits like its Normal rank 2102615 at the caster's level, 285 of 937.5 direct (0.304) and 8 per 3 s instead of 75 per 2 s on the poison (0.0711). A caster of level 50 or more deals the Heroic damage / 1.66 * 0.85 instead (0.703 / 1.66 * 0.85 = 0.36). A kit spell that is its own Normal rank (Nightmare Rift 2102729) keeps its value, and a spell outside the kits (Poison Cloud 3815) is untouched. No single hit takes more than 25% of a player's maximum health from an area spell. Measured on the module damage-taken hooks from a fixed 1000, with each caster at the level of the player it hits so level scaling stays out of the figures. In a dungeon the core casts a spell's SpellDifficulty tier for the map's difficulty, on Normal the first one, as Ascension's Normal logs show (Lord Serpentis casts 2102615): from a kit creature below level 50 that Normal tier keeps its own value and the hit cap, from one of level 50 or more it deals the row's Heroic share of the level-60 tier (0.36 * 937.5 / 285 = 1.184), and from a creature without a kit it stays untouched.
